Two tiers. **You only ever pick the first group.** Everything in the second
group is doctrine the agent self-invokes at the right moment — surfaced
automatically by `tools/memory/skill_router_hook.py` from each skill's
`triggers`. If you are ever unsure which to use: you almost certainly want
nothing — describe the problem and the agent routes itself.

## Your commands (`/<name>`)

The only skills meant for you to invoke directly.

- **`/clear-cache`** — Clear Halo CE cache files from Xbox devkit cache partitions
- **`/handover`** — Create a concise continuation handover for Halo CE Xbox RE/lift work when the user runs /handover or asks to transfer context to a new agen…
- **`/input-fixture`** — Interactive wizard to record or replay a controller-input fixture for a Halo CE level.
- **`/reintegrate-to-main`** — "Re-integrate a lift/session worktree branch into main: rebase, gate (kb.json whole-object partition, build, no-drop), fast-forward main."
